Over 200,000 people watched our last video on demonic possession. Why? Because spiritual warfare is real—and more people are waking up to it.
In this follow-up, we go even deeper: Why do people get possessed? And more importantly—how can they be set free?
We sit down with Tim Maddocks, a missionary who has seen firsthand the power of Jesus to deliver people from demonic oppression. With decades of experience, Tim has prayed over countless individuals bound by darkness—and watched them be completely transformed by the power of Christ.
If you’ve ever opened spiritual doors—through occult practices, music, drugs, or trauma—this video is for you. You’ll learn the biblical principles of deliverance, the real signs of possession, and the steps to freedom through Jesus Christ.
You don’t have to stay bound. The same Jesus who cast out demons in the Bible is still setting people free today.
